chunks.head: drift away from
chunks.gloss: (思绪/注意力)渐渐从…上移开;漂离
chunks.note: 字面指漂流离开;本章指心思从烦恼上转移开去。

literal.note_cn: 此处指思绪游移,非水上漂流

chunks.ex_en: My thoughts drifted away from the boring lecture.
chunks.ex_cn: 我的思绪从无聊的讲座上飘走了。

chunks.head: hang around
chunks.note: 指无所事事地待在某处或其附近。
chunks.ex_en: The boys like to hang around the park after school.
chunks.ex_cn: 男孩们放学后喜欢在公园里闲逛。

chunks.head: all manner of
chunks.note: manner 此处意为“种类”;等于 all kinds of。
chunks.ex_en: The little shop sells all manner of old toys.
chunks.ex_cn: 这家小店卖各种各样的旧玩具。

chunks.head: at once
chunks.note: 本章为“立即”义;另有“同时”义(如 all at once)。
chunks.ex_en: Stop that and come here at once!
chunks.ex_cn: 别闹了,马上给我过来！

chunks.head: break up
chunks.note: 本章指打破(冷漠的)僵局;也可指散会、分手、驱散人群。
chunks.ex_en: The teacher came over to break up the fight.
chunks.ex_cn: 老师走过来制止了这场打斗。

chunks.head: at any cost
chunks.gloss: 不惜一切代价;无论如何
chunks.note: cost 此处指“代价”,不专指金钱花费。
chunks.ex_en: We must win this game at any cost.
chunks.ex_cn: 这场比赛我们必须不惜一切代价拿下。

chunks.head: think over
chunks.note: over 表来回琢磨、反复权衡。
chunks.ex_en: Please think over my offer before you say no.
chunks.ex_cn: 在拒绝之前,请你仔细考虑一下我的提议。

chunks.head: hit upon
chunks.note: 也作 hit on;指灵光一现想出主意或办法。
chunks.ex_en: She hit upon a clever way to save money.
chunks.ex_cn: 她突然想到一个省钱的妙招。

chunks.head: be fond of
chunks.note: 后接名词或动名词;语气比 like 略深、略正式。
chunks.ex_en: My little sister is fond of cats.
chunks.ex_cn: 我妹妹很喜欢猫。

chunks.head: help oneself
chunks.note: help oneself to sth = 自己随便拿/吃;待客常用语。

literal.note_cn: 此处指“自行取用”,非“帮助别人”

chunks.ex_en: Help yourself to some cake, please.
chunks.ex_cn: 请随便吃点蛋糕。

chunks.head: occur to somebody
chunks.gloss: (念头)浮现在某人脑中;某人想到
chunks.note: 常用 it occurs to sb that... = 某人突然想到…。
chunks.ex_en: It never occurred to me that he might be lying.
chunks.ex_cn: 我从没想到他可能在撒谎。

chunks.head: in the act of
chunks.gloss: 正在做…时(常指干坏事被撞见)
chunks.note: 常见搭配 catch sb in the act = 当场抓住某人。
chunks.ex_en: The thief was caught in the act of stealing.
chunks.ex_cn: 小偷正偷东西时被当场抓住。

chunks.head: set off
chunks.gloss: 出发,动身;(此处)猛地冲出去
chunks.note: 常指启程赶路;也可指引发、引爆。本章指猫一下子冲出去狂奔。
chunks.ex_en: We set off for the mountains early in the morning.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们一大早就出发去山里了。

chunks.head: what on earth
chunks.gloss: 究竟…;到底…(表惊讶或不解的加强语气)
chunks.note: on earth 加在疑问词后加强语气,可换 how/why/where on earth。

literal.note_cn: 此处不表实义,纯加强语气

chunks.ex_en: What on earth are you doing up there?
chunks.ex_cn: 你在上面到底在干什么？

chunks.head: have a good time
chunks.note: 聚会、旅行、活动之后的高频口语。
chunks.ex_en: We had a good time at the party last night.
chunks.ex_cn: 昨晚在派对上我们玩得很开心。

chunks.head: have to do with
chunks.note: 常说 have something/nothing to do with = 与…有/无关系。
chunks.ex_en: This problem has nothing to do with me.
chunks.ex_cn: 这个问题跟我一点关系都没有。

chunks.head: do somebody good
chunks.gloss: 对某人有好处;使某人受益
chunks.note: do sb good = 有益于某人;good 此处作名词“好处”。
chunks.ex_en: A walk in the fresh air will do you good.
chunks.ex_cn: 到新鲜空气里散散步对你有好处。

chunks.head: ahead of time
chunks.note: = in advance;比预定时间早。
chunks.ex_en: Let me know ahead of time if you can't come.
chunks.ex_cn: 如果你来不了,请提前告诉我。

chunks.head: show off
chunks.note: 故意展示以博取关注;可及物 show off sth。
chunks.ex_en: He likes to show off his new phone to everyone.
chunks.ex_cn: 他喜欢向每个人炫耀他的新手机。

chunks.head: sneak off
chunks.note: 悄悄地、不引人注意地离开。
chunks.ex_en: He tried to sneak off before the meeting ended.
chunks.ex_cn: 他想在会议结束前偷偷溜走。

chunks.head: keep an eye out
chunks.note: keep an eye out for sth = 留意寻找、注意提防。本章出处被 furtive 隔开,故 card-only。
chunks.ex_en: Keep an eye out for a red car—that's my dad.
chunks.ex_cn: 留意一辆红色的车,那是我爸。
